equipment_id.description: Identifier of the equipment the reading belongs to

device_id.description: Identifier of the device that produced the reading

min_temperature.description: Calibrated minimum temperature observed in the window, in Celsius

max_temperature.description: Calibrated maximum temperature observed in the window, in Celsius

avg_temperature.description: Calibrated average temperature observed in the window, in Celsius

raw_min_temperature.description: Minimum temperature measured by the probe before calibration, in Celsius

raw_max_temperature.description: Maximum temperature measured by the probe before calibration, in Celsius

raw_avg_temperature.description: Average temperature measured by the probe before calibration, in Celsius

humidity.description: Average relative humidity observed in the window, as a percentage

sample_count.description: Number of raw samples folded into this reading

light_level_max.description: Highest light level inside the unit, 0 to 100 %; null when not reported

door_open_seconds.description: Seconds the door was detected open; null when not reported

presence_detected.description: Whether presence was detected near the unit; null when presence is unavailable

recorded_at.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) Timestamp assigned by the device clock

applied_config_version.description: Edge configuration version the gateway was running

under_maintenance.description: Whether a maintenance window covered recorded_at; such readings never change an alert
